title: Executive Experience and Human Governance Correction
objective: Make Flora present imported Twin intelligence as an executive product, ensure subject pages contain only canonically relevant intelligence, and align pilot governance language with the Chief Architect's actual human review workflow.
implementation_summary: A shared structured executive formatter now presents nested canonical values as labelled facts, lists and cards.
Executive routes now separate factual inventory, uncertainty, assessment readiness and technical diagnostics.
Canonical association fields exclusively control Enterprise programme and Opportunity relevance.
Advanced Inspection retains full technical lineage behind summaries, filters and collapsed traces.
expected_visible_outcomes: No raw dictionaries or snake case fields on executive pages.
No runtime fingerprints on executive pages.
Clear Industry economics and commercial implications.
Clear Enterprise facts and residual gaps.
Corrected Twin Map wording and glyphs.
Improved Advanced Inspection and Explore Twin hierarchy.
unchanged_areas: Importer, validator, adapter, semantic construction, Canonical Factual Projection semantics, Observation runtime, owner assessment, Research Gaps logic, executive page semantics, TEL-001 fixture, governance and promotion remain unchanged by this operational acceptance panel.
TEL-001 package contents and checksum remain unchanged.
No automatic acceptance, promotion, recommendations or TEL-001-specific production logic is introduced.
required_test_steps: Confirm executive pages contain no raw mappings, snake case labels or runtime fingerprints.
Confirm BT Group shows only canonically related programmes and opportunities.
Confirm Industry values, Research Gaps, Reinvention dispositions and diagnostics reconcile.
Use browser print preview for the six primary print routes.
fresh_import_policy: Fresh import is required only when the approved change is live and material runtime components that affect candidate representation changed before the candidate was imported. UI-only, presentation-only and diagnostics-only panel changes do not require reimport. If timestamps or component classification are unavailable, Flora reports Cannot determine rather than forcing a reimport.
known_limitations: Operator validation cannot be inferred from repository tests and remains NOT TESTED until a human records PASS, PARTIAL or FAIL outside this repository-owned metadata.

Deployment telemetry can remain incomplete when Render does not expose build timestamp, service, repository or release marker environment variables to the running application; the panel then degrades to Metadata incomplete rather than reporting a wrong commit.
Rendered-route tests prove the acceptance panel content is visible; they do not prove a live Render deployment has been manually inspected.
Human review is recorded by the Chief Architect in the existing Review stage; promotion, assessment and recommendation eligibility remain separate.
TEL-001 Twin Map and BT Group HTML artefacts were produced; browser screenshots/PDFs were unavailable because the optional Playwright package is not installed.
The unchanged legacy regression contains assertions for technical count copy that the current presentation specification explicitly prohibits; replacement acceptance snapshots remain follow-up work.
